reason: The CIF parses and primitive-standardizes as an ordered, fully occupied nine-atom P1 cell with composition Y(BRh)4 and volume 135.8366 A^3, but the realization is not established by the diffraction evidence. Its lattice has no reflection within 0.33 degrees of the important observed 31.68-degree line (intensity 17.6 on a 100 scale), and only 28 of 38 prominence>=3 observed peaks are covered within 0.05 degrees. A direct profile audit gives signal cosine about 0.866 and normalized residual about 0.500, while predicting large peaks into clean baseline near 25.82, 37.68, and 41.94 degrees and substantially missing observed intensity near 40.86, 49.16, 52.15, 62.06, and 62.58 degrees. The trace obtained the coordinates from one highly flexible P1 relaxation of an assumed prototype, without independent map/search convergence or a comparable refined atomic-model residual; nearby Y/Rh orderings remain nearly score-degenerate. The relaxation also creates 1.45 A Y-B and Rh-B contacts. Another attempt is therefore likely to produce a materially different viable candidate.
